text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The annual summer training camp—in this refreshing new environment,
Bamboo Memory put even more passion into her training.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Feel the burn! Hot-blooded training!!
Summer Camp Edition: Part Teeeeen!!!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Phaaah!
How was that?! What'd you think of my beach dash?!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Alright! The sand puts a heavy load on your legs,
but not having to worry about hoof wear is a huge plus!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
...Hm?
Those two over there... from the arcade incident—

text_block_list.name: Familiar Horsegirls
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaaah!!!

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl B
text_block_list.text:
Hehe♪
At this rate, looks like we'll wrap up early, huh?

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl A
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, totally!
We worked so hard, we deserve to have a little fun, right?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Heh... Blowing off steam is important, after all.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Alright, time for another set for me toooo!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Huh?
Those two haven't come back yet?

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl C
text_block_list.text:
Yeah...
I sent them messages, but getting no response.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Mmmgh, this is a grave situation!
Did they mention where they were going?!

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl C
text_block_list.text:
Not really... but earlier, some random guy was talking to them.
Saying stuff like he'd show them around, or they should hang out—

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: That's it!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
The Disciplinary Committee protects students in danger!
I'm going to save them!!

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl C
text_block_list.text:
Ah, wait, shouldn't we contact a Trainer
or an adult first...?!

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl C
text_block_list.text:
...We really should, right?
Umm, Bamboo's Trainer is—

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl A
text_block_list.text: Hmm... Was this really a good idea?

text_block_list.name: Shady Guy
text_block_list.text:
Totally fine, totally fine!
Nobody's gonna notice if you're a little late♪

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
HOLD IT RIGHT THERE!
Everyone already noticed!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Keep this up and a strict warning won't be the end of it!
Both of you, come back with me right now!

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl B
text_block_list.text: There you go again...! We just—!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Having fun is just as important as running, right?
Probably just as important as kendo is to me...

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl A
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
I learned that lesson too.
How fun and important it is to blow off steam—

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
But if you break the rules like this, you won't be able to run OR have fun!
That would be an absolute waste!

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl B
text_block_list.text:
M-Mind your own business!
You don't know the first thing about us!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
...It's true, I might not know
every single detail about you.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
But there's one thing I know for sure!
You're horsegirls who want to win your races!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
If you just wanted to mess around, you could do that anytime. But you
power through grueling training and keep pouring your souls into running!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
You have dreams, right?! You have that burning desire to win!
But if you cause trouble here, you'll throw all of that away...

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: I can't stand the thought of that happening!!

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl B
text_block_list.text: Committee head...

text_block_list.name: Shady Guy
text_block_list.text:
Listen, that whole hot-blooded straight shooter routine?
It's totally out of style. Ancient history, kid.

text_block_list.name: Shady Guy
text_block_list.text:
These girls said they wanna come, so back off.
Come on, let's go, girls.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Hey, hold on! Stop right there!!

text_block_list.name: Shady Guy
text_block_list.text:
Let go!
...Damn it! My bag...!

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl B
text_block_list.text:
What is this memo...
'Prestigious Tracen Academy Students Night Out During Training Camp'...?!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
This phone has video recording turned on... I see now.
You're a tabloid paparazzi fishing for a scandal!

text_block_list.name: Shady Guy
text_block_list.text: You little punk...! Give that back right now!!

text_block_list.name: Police Officer
text_block_list.text: You there, freeze! Police!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Just in the nick of time—right before the suspicious man could grab
Bamboo Memory, we managed to rush in alongside the police.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Trainer?!
The police too... but why...
choice_data_list: One of the students told me you guys might be in danger.
One of the students told me you guys might be in danger.

text_block_list.name: Police Officer
text_block_list.text:
That wraps it up.
...Alright pal, let's hear the rest of your story down at the station!

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl A
text_block_list.text: Th-That was so scary...!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Everything's okay now!
Public order has been successfully defended!
choice_data_list: It is NOT okay at all!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Huh?
choice_data_list: I was terrified you'd get caught up in something dangerous!
I was terrified you'd get caught up in an incident!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: I-I'm really sorry, sir...

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl B
text_block_list.text: Pfft, look who's getting an earful~

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
S-Shut it! You're the ones who
got us into this mess in the first place—

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl A
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, we were in the wrong. The Disciplinary
Committee head was genuinely worried about us, too.

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl B
text_block_list.text:
Well, we definitely learned our lesson. Besides...
we've got one too, y'know. A dream of our own, that is.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Then that's all that matters!
Let's all sprint toward our dreams at full throttle together, sirrr!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After that, the two girls strictly adhered to the rules,
and had the time of their lives letting loose at the
summer festival held on the final day of the training camp.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Right on! Keeping it wholesome while running
and having fun is definitely the best, sir!
choice_data_list: Make sure you enjoy yourself too, Bamboo.
You have some fun too, Bamboo.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Yes, sir! I'll uphold discipline, take a breather,
and absolutely win every single race!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
But... if I ever make a mistake like this again,
please make sure to scold me properly, sir.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! I look forward to working hard
under your guidance, sir!!
